test_is_nunchaku_available: test if the nunchaku package is available in the current environment
create_nunchaku_config: create a NunchakuConfig instance with int4 precision and rank 32 for SVDQuant W4A4 quantization
build_nunchaku_config_from_dict: build a NunchakuConfig from a dictionary containing precision, rank, and group_size settings
build_nunchaku_config_from_pretrained: build a NunchakuConfig by loading quantization settings from a pretrained model directory
run_patch_nunchaku_scales: run patching of wtscale and wcscales tensors from safetensors weights onto a model for NVFP4 correctness
